description: This file defines an Android activity, 'HelloEffects', which applies various visual effects to images using OpenGL ES and the Android media effect API. It manages the rendering surface, loads textures from resources, initializes different effects based on user selection, and renders the effects in real-time.

classes.name: HelloEffects
classes.description: Main activity class that handles image effect rendering using OpenGL ES and Android's media effect API.

methods.name: setCurrentEffect
methods.description: Sets the current effect to be applied based on user selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the GLSurfaceView, and prepares for rendering.

methods.name: loadTextures
methods.description: Generates textures and loads the input bitmap resource into OpenGL textures.

methods.name: initEffect
methods.description: Creates and initializes the selected media effect based on the current user choice.

methods.name: applyEffect
methods.description: Applies the initialized effect to the input texture and renders to the output texture.

methods.name: renderResult
methods.description: Renders either the effect-applied texture or the original bitmap depending on the current effect state.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Main rendering loop, initializes resources if needed, applies effects, and renders the scene.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the rendering surface size.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Placeholder for surface creation; no specific implementation here.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for effect selection.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections by updating the current effect and requesting a re-render.
